## Households

Adopt the hygiene disciplines together: an intentional media diet anchored in reputable local sources; verification before sharing (make "did we check this?" a family reflex); emotional checking — pausing to notice anger or fear before engaging; regular digital fasting; and privacy practices that shrink the surface available for microtargeting. Model mindful engagement: be the voice of reason and empathy you wish the feed had.
